headline: A
label: JevBench v1.6.3 · fresh paid native cohort
measurement_notes: Refusals, errors and context-bound failures remain in the full 1,500 denominator. Native package/model/runtime/context settings remain those of each independently reviewed measurement; no inference is rerun for this metadata enrichment.

Reference token costs use a common 1,479-item set: 21 items are excluded from cost using an input-only rule based on state plus the longest question and the current public reference limit of 32,736 tokens. The empirical historical accepted/refused gap does not identify the exact historical cap, and token-length reconstruction extrapolates beyond the historical approximately 2,300-token region. This is a dated convention with uncertainty, not an exact or stationary historical tariff/input claim. The 21 exclusions do not reduce the full 1,500 capability denominator. The official cost normalizer C0 is USD 0.001 per 1,000 decisions, with 30 cost points per decade.

The fixed prospective six-member roster currently has four complete eligible native nonwrapper field-median members: Jeff-1.0-Large, Wald 4B, Metask rain 4B and Decisor 4B. Metask rain 12B is listed below the ranking and excluded from G_med; RYOTIDE remains pending. Bootstrap B=1000, seed=16 holds G_med fixed; published confidence intervals therefore omit field-median uncertainty. This small-field release is not directly comparable with larger-field or earlier-draw scores.

Base-reference prices are labelled estimates with mixed historical cut-off and current public-provider dates; they are neither invoices nor bookable package hosting tariffs. Per-system cost basis preserves its exact documented source/date/precision convention.

Capability is mean(Intelligence, Calibration). The eligibility envelope remains the historical fixed Jev 1.13.0 v1.5.7 reference, not a newly measured API: USD 0.06459465517241379 per 1,000 and p50 1.2329566404223442 seconds caps. Composite is secondary.
Historical catalogue and scores/dates remain unchanged. The fresh version is added separately and retains all required page sections; pending candidates are not disguised as completed results.
source_note: Actual five completed systems on the same fresh draw, full1500 denominator and O1S scoring. Four eligible native nonwrapper members form the whole-field median, fixed during B1000/seed16 bootstrap. Metask12B is displayed below ranking and excluded from median. RYOTIDE remains pending. Original raw measurements and v1.6.2 publication remain unchanged; current field-relative values come exclusively from actual official recomputation.

cost.basis: Estimated public reference: $0.08/M input and $0.13/M output from the nearest larger priced same-family Qwen3.5-9B Darkbloom endpoint. This is a larger-base proxy, not an exact Decisor-4B tariff or measured hosting cost. The provider reference uses fp4 while Decisor uses native FP8. Source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/qwen/qwen3.5-9b/endpoints.

Public exact base-model OpenRouter reference for google/gemma-4-31b-it, 2026-10-09: cheapest paid DeepInfra Turbo $0.09/M input, $0.34/M output. Jeff uses native bf16 single forward-pass decision readout with zero generated output tokens. Reference tariff is not an actual Jeff hosting bill. Primary source https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/google/gemma-4-31b-it/endpoints; source receipt retained.
